description: 把散乱业务规则写成经得起合规检查的制度：4步定范围、8段式条款结构、12项红区筛查、未成年人保护五件套、留痕自证设计，一次产出制度/SOP/员工手册。源自真实产品的4红区整改回路。技术触发词「制度起草、SOP流程、合规红区」。口语触发词「帮我把这份制度草稿过一遍合规红区，别等签下去了才发现要返工、搭一份员工手册的框架，重点是出事时真能用上的那些条款」。输出可直接使用的清单、对照表与行动项。仅作规划与清单辅助，不构成法律/税务/医疗专业意见，需人工复核。 Enterprise policy, SOP and staff handbook drafter that produces compliance-grade documents: scope matching, clause structure, red-line screening, minor-protection clauses, dispute-evidence clauses, and version control. Built from a real 4-red-zone compliance remediation case. Covers: 制度起草, SOP流程, 合规红区. Use when the user asks to policy drafting. Trigger phrases: SOP workflow; compliance red zones. Enterprise policy, SOP and staff handbook drafter that produces compliance-grade documents: scope matching, clause structure, red-line screening, minor-protection clauses, dispute-evidence clauses,. Output: structured checklist, comparison table, and prioritized action list. Planning aid only, not professional legal, tax, or medical advice; human review required. English edition and bundles: https://www.agensi.io/r/CREATOR8796142 (catalogue: https://github.com/Tingyun01/tingyun-skills).
